scope: Offline infrastructure, ingest publisher and AWS guard checks in the saved Linux cloud coding environment. No AWS account was contacted.

environment.node_limit: Tests used the provided Node 24 runtime, not the project Node 22 major. No project runtime pins were changed.

dependency_setup.command: python3 -m venv /tmp/calm-aws-venv && /tmp/calm-aws-venv/bin/python -m pip install -r pipeline/infra/requirements.txt pytest==9.1.1 moto==5.2.3 boto3==1.43.97

initial_attempts.result: Collection error before tests ran: jsii could not create /home/agent/.cache/aws/jsii/package-cache.
Same jsii cache-path error before synthesis.

cache_resolution: Set the supported JSII_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CACHE_ROOT=/tmp/calm-aws-jsii-cache. No permission escalation, credentials, account changes or source edits.

offline_test.command: env JSII_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CACHE_ROOT=/tmp/calm-aws-jsii-cache AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true /tmp/calm-aws-venv/bin/python -m pytest pipeline/tests/test_infra.py pipeline/tests/test_infra_ingest.py pipeline/tests/test_aws_guard.py -q -ra --junitxml=/tmp/calm-aws-tests.xml
offline_test.limits: Infrastructure assertions synthesize templates; ingest tests use moto with a controlled pipeline stub. They do not execute real AWS, production video preparation, billing or vulnerability scanning.

offline_synth.command: env JSII_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CACHE_ROOT=/tmp/calm-aws-jsii-cache AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=000000000000 CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 CDK_OUTDIR=/tmp/calm-aws-cdk-out /tmp/calm-aws-venv/bin/python app.py
offline_synth.configuration: Default context; synthetic account; no signing key parameter, budget email or GitHub OIDC context.
